summary: roles/microk8s/handlers/main.yml gains a check-mode-only debug handler listening on each of Restart microk8s, Rollout-restart coredns and Restart microk8s kubelite, so a --check run reports each would-be restart as a change on every notified host while the real handlers stay untouched and skipped. Proven with scratch playbooks on ansible-core 2.20.5 against local throwaway hosts; the ansible gate is green; not live-proven.
